entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand you sent me. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you kidding me? Of course it's a fault! The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracker, is completely broken. It's not working at all!
Okay, I understand. Can you describe what's happening when you say it's not working?

It won't sync the pulse data to the app, and half the time the band itself says my heart rate is 40 when I'm on a run! It's defective. The whole thing is broken. I want a refund, not a 20-question interrogation.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble. I just need to ask these questions to determine the best way to help you.
The best way to help is to give me my money back! I'm done with this. Get me your manager right now. I'm about to post a review on every single website about this defective garbage.
That won't be necessary, I'm sure I can resolve this for you. Let me just pull up your purchase details and review the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 26 days ago. Let me just check the policy... Yes, according to our system, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Well, finally. So you're going to process the refund?

Absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're within the timeframe, I have gone ahead and approved that for you. I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. About time. Make sure that email comes through immediately.
It's already been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
